summary: Join this public policy development and governance training course. Gain the knowledge and skills needed to excel in administration and drive impactful change.
lede: Public policy courses teach public-sector professionals to analyze societal challenges and design structured interventions. They cover Regulatory Impact Analysis, cost-benefit analysis and the Logical Framework Approach for assessing policy options and planning programs, as well as stakeholder prioritization and performance measures. Participants also practice drafting policy briefs and building monitoring frameworks to track service delivery and respond to risks.
audienceIntro: This training is essential for professionals responsible for the design, implementation, and oversight of public sector initiatives and institutional governance.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of public sector structures and at least two years of experience in an administrative or policy-related role. No prior knowledge of specific governance standards is required, but familiarity with departmental reporting processes is beneficial.
